notes.subject: להדרת קדש
notes.rationale: 'hadarathi ya ũtheru' — kĩhungĩro gĩa gũtaũra: 'kũhecura ũtheru mwĩhanya' (ASV), 'kũhecura ndũrũrĩ-inĩ ya theru' (Geneva), kana 'kũhecura hĩndĩ ya ũtheru' — meciria mawĩrĩ nĩmahĩthagĩrĩka thĩinĩ wa kĩugo kĩmwe.

notes.subject: acaini
notes.rationale: משררים nĩ 'arĩa mahota kĩĩrĩa' — 'acaini' nĩ kĩugo kĩa Gĩkũyũ gĩakĩrĩkĩraga kĩĩrĩa na kũina hamwe.

notes.subject: לעולם
notes.rationale: Ibukabukĩrĩro rĩa Kĩhibirania 'kuuma thutha wa kũona' rĩtaũrwo ta 'age na tene na thamaki' — kĩugo kĩrĩa gĩtikũgĩa kĩmĩena.

notes.subject: Mũthũrei Yahwe
notes.rationale: Kĩugo kĩa thahau kĩa Ebedi ya Babilonia nĩkĩhootanĩra andũ aria methĩtie ita mĩena ĩrĩ hamwe na kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa Yahwe (Amosi 136:1).

notes.subject: הודו / יהודה
notes.rationale: Hodi (yadah) na Yehuda nĩmahĩtanĩte metha-inĩ ma Kĩhibirania — kĩrathani kĩa Yehocafathi kĩambatagĩra rĩĩtwa rĩa bũrũri ũrĩa wĩ moko mabere.

translation: Akĩcĩranĩra na andũ-arĩa, akĩmĩkĩra acaini a Yahwe na arĩa makũhura na hadarathi ya ũtheru, hĩndĩ ya kũgitha mbere ya arĩa amĩtwo ita, na makĩuga: Mũthũrei Yahwe, nĩgũkorua hecedi wakĩo age na tene na thamaki.
